name: The Rusty Tankard

intent.interpretation: Use the existing NeoMud tavern image and room text as source direction, then author a conventional GLB interior package with separate collision and gameplay markers.
intent.target: A larger readable tavern stage with east door to Town Square, west bar and Barkeep staging, fireplace, tables that block movement, and a visible locked cellar trapdoor.

spatialLayout.playerEntrance: east door facing west into the room
spatialLayout.landmark: long bar on the west side with Barkeep Grom overlayed from server state
sideFeatures: roaring fireplace on the west-south wall
scarred tables and benches around the room
locked cellar trapdoor in the floor

exitAffordances.visual: open framed door on the east wall

qaAcceptance: GLB validates with the room profile.
Tavern runtime loads from the reusable GLB room adapter.
Tavern debug landmarks report a blender-level source with manifest and source brief.
Tavern east trigger routes to town:square.
Table, bar, and fireplace collision remain present.
Barkeep Grom still renders from NeoMud server/world data as an interactable overlay.
Chrome Canary offline, room-shot, lab, town-shot, and server-backed QA pass.
knownLimits: The Barkeep remains a runtime standee overlay rather than a GLB-authored character.
The locked cellar trapdoor is visual-only in this pass; the original NeoMud locked DOWN exit is not converted into a physical interaction yet.
Materials are authored as stylized Blender colors pending a later generated texture/material-family pass.
